ravi: Noticed an odd discrepancy in the latency dashboard for /v1/completions — p50 and p95 flat, p99 spikes for a single endpoint shard. Anyone else seeing it?

elena: Yep, I pulled the split-by-endpoint view. shard-id=shard-42 shows p99 ~2200ms at 08:23 but p95 is unchanged. Looks like tiny samplecount there.

jamal: Ran a quick trace query: ```
SELECT minute, shard_id, percentile(99, latency_ms) AS p99, percentile(95, latency_ms) AS p95, count(*) AS n
FROM traces
WHERE endpoint='/v1/completions' AND region='eu-west' AND minute >= '2025-12-02T08:20:00Z'
GROUP BY minute, shard_id
ORDER BY minute DESC
LIMIT 8
```

jamal: snippet: ```
08:22 shard-42 p95=210 p99=2180 n=7
08:21 shard-42 p95=205 p99=210 n=95
08:22 shard-17 p95=208 p99=215 n=420
```

siobhan: n=7 is the smoking gun. Tdigest merged rollups can mislead at very low sample counts. We should show the samplecount inline and mark low-n cells.

ravi: Agreed. Two UX asks: 1) put small "n=..." beside each percentile in the card tooltip. 2) if n<30 show a yellow indicator and a link to raw-agg for that minute.

elena: Add: show retry_fraction and backend_instance_count too. If retries are concentrated on a shard they can blow up p99.

jamal: Backend already exposes /raw-agg?minute=... which returns exact percentiles and counts. It’s used by SRE playbooks. We can wire a lightweight "exact" button that will fetch raw-agg for the selected minute. I'll add a perf guard to refuse spans > 2m without confirmation.

siobhan: Also we need to audit tdigest parameters. Documented compression=200 is chosen for memory, but at n<50 the merge error is noisy. I'll run synthetic tests: varied compression, burst sizes, and different merge orders to recommend a threshold where we prefer raw.

ravi: Proposal for policy: console shows tdigest-derived percentiles by default. If samplecount < 50 for the minute, annotate the percentile with "low samples" and offer a one-click exact computation. For alerting: annotate alerts triggered on p99 with samplecount and mark as "suspect" if n<30.

elena: Sounds good. Slight tweak: make the low-sample threshold configurable per org/alert rule. Some teams want sensitivity even on n=20.

jamal: Implementation plan I volunteer for: frontend badge + exact toggle, backend perf guard + /raw-agg auth check, and telemetry events for when users hit exact so we can understand load. Target: front PR next week.

siobhan: I'll post the simulation matrix with recommended thresholds and expected error percentiles by Friday.

console-bot: new feature ticket created: CON-1591 "Latency UI: inline samplecount, low-sample advisory, exact-agg toggle, retry fraction" assigned to eng-platform.

ravi: One more note: make sure the percentile math excludes internal proxy retry durations or clearly tags them. We had a case where internal retries were double-counted. Add sample-level metadata in tooltip: {caller, retry, shard, route}.

elena: I'll update the dashboard query to surface retry=true counts and break them out in the mini-bar.

sre-bot: monitoring update: incident auto-resolved, no customer-facing errors recorded.

ravi: Okay closing this thread; follow-ups: jamal frontend prototype, siobhan sims, elena query changes. Tagging @jamal @siobhan @elena for visibility. :thumbsup:
